titles.title: I Will Offer Up My Life

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I will offer up my life in spirit and truth
Pouring out the oil of love, as my worship to You
In surrender I must give my every part
Lord, receive this sacrifice of a broken heart

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Jesus, what can I give, what can I bring
To so faithful a Friend, to so loving a King?
Savior, what can be said, what can be sung
As a praise of Your name for the things You have done?

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You deserve my every breath, for You've paid the great cost
Pouring out Your life to death, even death on a cross
You took all my shame away, there defeated my sin
Opened up the gates of heaven and have welcomed me in

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
We'll bring an offering, unto You an offering
What can I, what can I, what can I sing as an offering, Lord?
I want to please Your heart
What can I give, what can I bring, what can I sing as an offering, Lord?

verse.name: i1
verse.lines: What can I give, what can I bring, what can I sing as an offering, Lord?

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Oh, my words could not tell, not even in part
Of the debt of love that is owed by this thankful heart
